name: Flux Payments Gateway for WooCommerce
author: nickkreissler59

sections.description:
Flux Payments Gateway for WooCommerce allows merchants to accept payments via Flux Payments.
Supported methods include:

  • Credit Card
  • ACH (Bank Transfer)
  • Cryptocurrency

When a customer checks out, they are redirected to Flux Payments’ secure hosted page to complete payment. Once payment is finalized, the order is automatically updated in WooCommerce.

Key Features
– Zero setup fees from Flux Payments.
– Accept credit card, ACH, and crypto.
– Product syncing from WooCommerce to Flux Payments.
– Support for physical and service-based products.
– Optional crypto asset & wallet selection.
– Simple configuration via WooCommerce settings.

External services

This plugin connects to the Flux Payments API to process payments and manage product synchronization. The plugin relies on external services provided by Flux Payments.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Flux Payments API (https://api.fluxpayments.com) is used to:
– Synchronize WooCommerce products with Flux Payments
– Create payment links for customer transactions
– Process payments via credit card, ACH, and cryptocurrency
– Retrieve transaction status and currency/wallet information

What data is sent and when:
– Product information (name, price, SKU, description, images) is sent when products are created or updated
– Order details (amount, currency, product IDs) are sent when creating payment links
– Transaction IDs are retrieved to verify payment completion
– Customer is redirected to Flux Payments hosted checkout page to complete payment

Service provider information:
This service is provided by Flux Payments. You can find their terms of service and privacy policy at:
– Terms of Service: https://fluxpayments.com/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://payments.fluxpayments.com/Policy_Privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable Flux Payments.
  4. Enter your Flux API key and configure available payment options (credit card, ACH, crypto).
  5. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support subscriptions?

Not at this time. Subscription/recurring payments support will be added in a future release.

Can I disable certain payment methods (e.g., crypto)?

Yes, you can enable/disable crypto support from the plugin settings.

Where do I get my Flux API key?

Log into your Flux Payments merchant dashboard and generate an API key.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Support for credit card, ACH, and crypto.
  • Product sync from WooCommerce to Flux.
  • Customizable payment gateway title and description.
  • Admin button to bulk-sync products.
  • Order status automatically updated upon Flux payment completion.
